system.name: AlphaSyndrome
system.one_liner: an automated synthesis framework using Monte Carlo Tree Search to schedule syndrome-measurement circuits that shape error propagation for general commuting-stabilizer QEC codes

content.subject: how a 5-tick syndrome-measurement circuit sequences Z-checks, X-checks, an idle tick, and a final ancilla measurement

elements.name: ticks
elements.role: names each of the 5 discrete time steps the circuit is divided into

elements.name: ancilla |0>
elements.role: the single ancilla qubit wire, initialized to |0>, that performs every Pauli check

elements.name: data
elements.role: the bundled data-qubit wires (four qubits) being checked

elements.name: CNOT
elements.role: a two-qubit gate performing one Pauli check between the ancilla and one data qubit

elements.name: H
elements.role: a Hadamard gate; paired before and after a CNOT turns it into an X-type check

elements.name: I
elements.role: an explicit idling gate marking a tick where the ancilla performs no check

elements.name: M_Z
elements.role: the final Z-basis measurement on the ancilla that reads out the syndrome result

elements.name: Idling
elements.role: an arrow callout naming the one idling gate the paper specifically discusses (tick 4)

relations.what: the ancilla participates in a Pauli check during ticks 1, 2, 3, and 5
each tick's check couples the ancilla to exactly one data qubit
a Hadamard before and after the same CNOT turns a Z-type check into an X-type check (ticks 3 and 5)
the ancilla idles during tick 4 instead of performing a check
after all five ticks the ancilla is measured in the Z basis to read out the syndrome

steps.what: a Pauli-Z check (CNOT, data qubit 1 as control, ancilla as target) between the ancilla and the first data qubit
steps.carries: Z-check between ancilla and data qubit 1

steps.what: a Pauli-Z check between the ancilla and the fourth (bottom) data qubit
steps.carries: Z-check between ancilla and data qubit 4

steps.what: a Pauli-X check (Hadamard, CNOT with ancilla as control, Hadamard) between the ancilla and the second data qubit
steps.carries: X-check between ancilla and data qubit 2

steps.what: the ancilla idles (explicit I gate) while no check is performed
a Pauli-X check between the ancilla and the third data qubit, followed by a Z-basis measurement (M_Z) on the ancilla
steps.carries: X-check between ancilla and data qubit 3, then measurement

content.key_idea: AlphaSyndrome represents a syndrome-measurement schedule as a tick-divided circuit: each tick performs at most one Pauli check per qubit (Z-check via a plain CNOT, X-check via a Hadamard-CNOT-Hadamard sandwich) or leaves the ancilla explicitly idling, ending in a Z-basis measurement.
content.reading_order: left to right across five dashed tick columns on the ancilla wire, following which data qubit each tick's CNOT connects to below; the callout arrow points out the one explicitly drawn idling gate at tick 4

style.icons: standard quantum-circuit glyphs only: filled dot (control), oplus (CNOT target), boxed H/I/M_Z (single-qubit gates/measurement)

evidence: An example syndrome measurement circuit with five ticks. Idlings are not all drawn explicitly.
The example in Figure 9 shows a five-tick syndrome measurement circuit, with different qubits idling on different ticks.
Notice that on the fourth tick, the ancilla qubit is idling.

summary: This figure shows AlphaSyndrome's tick-based representation of a syndrome-measurement schedule as a concrete example circuit. The single ancilla qubit, initialized to |0>, runs through five dashed-divided ticks: tick 1 and tick 2 each perform a plain-CNOT Pauli-Z check against one data qubit; tick 3 performs a Hadamard-CNOT-Hadamard Pauli-X check against a different data qubit; tick 4 leaves the ancilla explicitly idling (marked 'I' and called out by an arrow, since the paper notes idling gates are not all drawn); and tick 5 performs one more X-check before the ancilla is measured in the Z basis (M_Z) to read out the syndrome. The figure demonstrates how AlphaSyndrome's scheduler assigns each Pauli check to a tick such that no qubit is used twice in the same tick.
summary_zh: 该图示AlphaSyndrome按tick调度的电路示例：辅助比特经5个tick，第1、2个tick各做一次Z校验，第3个tick做X校验，第4个tick显式闲置(箭头标出)，第5个tick再做X校验后测量读出结果。
